data.title: Official: Como hand new contract extension to top goalscorer Douvikas - Yahoo Sports
data.content: Como have officially announced that the club's top goalscorer Tasos Douvikas has put pen to paper on a new long-term contract that will see him through until the summer of 2031. The Greece international had already been tied to a contract that was due to expire in the summer of 2029, but has seen his deal extended after an excellent start to the 2026-27 campaign, which has brought eight goals from 11 appearances at club level thus far. ITALY – OCTOBER 21: Tasos Douvikas scores his team's second goal during the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD3 match between Como 1907 and Manchester United at Giuseppe Sinigaglia Stadium on October 21, 2026 in Italy. Douvikas is Como's leading goalscorer across all competitions and in each individual competition with five goals from eight appearances in Serie A and three from three in the Champions League.
